items.title: A.B. Spellman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 19, 2022

ctx.x: I don’t think that’s true. That’s one of the myths about art is that you’ve got to be miserable and alienated. That isn’t true at all. I’ve been happy most of my life, not to name myself a great artist but I don’t find that I made better work when I was depressed and miserable than I did when I was happy. I don’t think that’s true of other artists as well. I feel like Cecil Taylor, he wasn’t a miserable person. He was basically in a good mood every time I saw him, most times that I saw him at any rate. Coltrane…
